name: sync-status
summary: One line that says where a person's changes are: saved, saving, offline or not saved, with Retry on a problem.

properties.name: status
properties.description: saved once changes reached the server, saving while they travel, offline while they wait on this device, error when the server refused them.

properties.name: onRetry
properties.description: Shows Retry while offline or error, and is called when it is pressed.

states.name: rest
states.description: Saved, offline or error, each with its own symbol and colour.

states.name: busy
states.description: Saving: the arrows turn, and hold still under reduced motion.

accessibility.name: Its words; spoken only when a problem starts and when saved follows one.
